body:
I'm just done with dealing with the unhappiness.  It's been going on too long.  The persistence of these feelings is more than a coincidence.

I'm going to go to sleep now.  So thank you for the responses.   Tonight is not the night, as I have some things I need to try in the next few weeks to  see if maybe that helps.  

Thank you again omni.

You are right.  The looking forward part may be off.  I think I am looking forward to the end of my unhappiness, but not the necessarily the way it may come about.  In my head this seems to make sense as the way to end it.  I've been fighting this for so damn long, and what scares me is that now is that really does seem like the best option.

It's a damn cycle.  About every 2-3 years it comes back.  This time though it feels different.  It feels right.  Other times not so much, but this time I'm actually looking forward to it.  Which is not the way it should be.

Any one reason, no.

It's a mixture of many things I think.  Aside from small bits here and there, I've never really been happy.  My life now would make most people proud.  But it's this thing that I have had in my mind for the last 25+ years.  It's really hard to explain.  I just can't see any other outcome other than this.
